bibliographic.title: Boss, we have a problem
bibliographic.author: Jackson_Miller
bibliographic.description:
You are a (aspiring) criminal mastermind with a brilliant plan to rob the city's largest bank. Everything seems set for you to hit the biggest score of your life- unless your stupid henchmen screw it all up, of course. Use text messages to guide your three eccentric and dubiously-competent minions through a high-stakes heist full of thrills, spelling errors, and impromptu Latin lessons.

This game was made using the Trialogue story format for Twine.
